start: Gym with a payment company connected; a payment link for a member's ₹1,500 due was made earlier and is still open; owner; the member now pays cash

steps.action: Open "Collect payment", leave the amount blank, set "Paid by" to cash
user_sees: The normal sheet; nothing about the open link
must_not: The sheet refusing cash because a link exists

steps.action: Tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "Saving…" a moment longer than usual, then "Payment saved. Receipt <number>."
must_not: The cash receipt saved while the link can still be paid

steps.action: Open the old link on a phone
user_sees: The link is closed and cannot be paid
must_not: The member able to pay the same ₹1,500 again

start: Same gym; the member paid the open link a moment ago with real money, and the owner does not know

steps.action: Open "Collect payment" and tap "Save payment" for cash
user_sees: "<Member name> has just paid ₹1,500 online, so this payment was not saved. The receipt for their online payment is made by itself in a few minutes."
The sheet stays open; "Save payment" is live again
must_not: A cash receipt saved on top of the online payment
The sheet closing with a success message

steps.action: Tap "Save payment" again
user_sees: The same message while the online payment covers the due
must_not: A second try going through

steps.action: Tap "Cancel" and open the member page a few minutes later
user_sees: One receipt, "Paid online", for ₹1,500; nothing due
must_not: No receipt at all
Two receipts

start: Same gym; an open link exists for the due; owner

steps.action: Turn the internet off and save a cash payment for that due
user_sees: The payment is kept on the device as in F-panel-421; the check with the server is skipped
must_not: The desk told the link was closed when it was not

steps.action: The member pays the still-open link before the device is back online
user_sees: Unknown from the code read: both the cash receipt and the online payment can exist for one due
must_not: The double payment going unnoticed: nothing in the code read tells the desk

steps.action: Back online, a link paid only with a TEST card exists for another due; save cash for it
user_sees: The cash payment is saved: a test payment does not count as paid
must_not: "has just paid ... online" for test money

start: Same gym; the member paid ₹500 of a ₹1,500 due through a link, and now pays the remaining ₹1,000 in cash; owner

steps.action: Open "Collect payment" and type 1000
user_sees: "Still due after this: ..." or "This clears all dues on this membership." as the sums say
must_not: The sheet still asking for ₹1,500 once the online ₹500 has its receipt

steps.action: Tap "Save payment"
user_sees: The ₹1,000 is saved: taking only the rest of a part payment made online is allowed
must_not: "has just paid ₹500 online, so this payment was not saved" for the rest of the due

start: Refund page says: "If you paid twice by mistake, or paid more than the price, we refund the extra amount."

steps.action: Take cash for a due that has an open link, online
user_sees: The link is closed first, so the member cannot pay twice
must_not: The member charged twice for one due

steps.action: Look for what the owner sees if a double payment still happens (cash saved offline, link paid meanwhile)
user_sees: Unknown: no screen for this was in the code read
must_not: The owner not learning that a refund is owed under the gym's and MettleUp's own words
